json.title: Disarming the Crab
json.designer_note: This 16x6 level tests navigating around hazards to dismantle the CRAB IS DEFEAT rule across 28 decision points. The puzzle's difficulty stems from a 28-move solution path that demands one deliberate sacrifice while avoiding three distinct trap states.
json.player_hint: Think about how to safely neutralize the dangerous crab, and remember that reaching your goal may require sacrificing an object.
